# 特征值与特征向量

Eigenvalues‑Eigenvectors

If $A$ is singular, $\lambda = 0$ is an eigenvalue.

[If $A$ is singular, $\lambda = 0$ is an eigenvalue.  是什么意思？](../appendices/21.md#if-a-is-singular-lambda-0-is-an-eigenvalue-是什么意思)

What are $\boldsymbol{x}$'s and $\lambda$'s for projection matrix?

[Pb 里的 b 是特征向量吗？](../appendices/21.md#pb-里的-b-是特征向量吗)

$$
\det\left[A-\lambda I\right] = 0
$$

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [3, 1],
    [1, 3],
])
display(*A.eigenvects())
display(A.trace())
```

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [0, -1],
    [1, 0],
])

display(A.trace())
display(A.det())
display(A.eigenvects())
```

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [3, 1],
    [0, 3],
])

display(A.trace())
display(A.det())
display(A.eigenvects())
```

$$
\mathrm{TRACE}= \lambda_1+\lambda_2+\dots+\lambda_n
$$
